description_en: Sets the property values for a specified device
description_zh: 调用该接口为指定设备设置属性值
name: SetDeviceProperty

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If the instance has an ID, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Instance Overview page or the ID is not displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The device ID. The ID is issued by IoT Platform and serves as the unique identifier of the device.
<notice> As the unique identifier of the device, IotId corresponds to the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。
<notice> IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en:
The property information to be set. The data format is JSON.

Each property consists of an identifier and a property value in the key:value format. Separate multiple properties with commas (,).

For example, set the following two properties of a smart light:

The switch property whose identifier is Switch. The data type is Bool and the value is set to 1 (on).

The color property whose identifier is Color. The data type is String and the value is set to blue.

The property information in JSON format is as follows:

`Items={"Switch":1,"Color":"blue"}`

If you set the properties of a custom module named testFb (not the default module), the format is: `Items={"testFb:Switch":1,"testFb:Color":"blue"}`
parameters.help_zh:
要设置的属性信息，数据格式为JSON。

每个属性信息由标识符与属性值 (key:value) 构成，多个属性用英文逗号隔开。

例如，设置智能灯的如下两个属性：

标识符为Switch的开关属性，数据类型为Bool，设置值为1（开）。

标识符为Color的灯颜色属性，数据类型为String，设置值为blue。

那么要设置的属性信息，JSON格式如下：

`Items={"Switch":1,"Color":"blue"}`

如果设置自定义模块testFb（非默认模块）的属性，则格式为：`Items={"testFb:Switch":1,"testFb:Color":"blue"}`
parameters.name: items

parameters.help_en:
The message delivery method when this API operation is called. Valid values:

0 (default): At most once.
1: At least once. If a message with QoS=1 does not receive a PUBACK message, the message is pushed to the device again when the device reconnects
parameters.help_zh:
指定调用本接口时，消息的发送方式。取值：

0（默认）：最多发送一次。
1：最少发送一次。如果QoS=1消息未接收到PUBACK消息，会在设备重连时，重新推送给设备
